NSBluetoothAlwaysUsageDescription: Tapiroute uses Bluetooth to read speed and distance from your treadmill, and your heart rate from a sensor.
NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: Tapiroute never uses your location: your routes start from the addresses you choose. The map library requires this text.
NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: Tapiroute uses your photos to set your profile picture.
NSAppleMusicUsageDescription: Tapiroute shows and controls the music you listen to during your session.
NSHealthShareUsageDescription: Tapiroute reads your heart rate during sessions and your steps of the day. This data stays on your phone.
NSHealthUpdateUsageDescription: Tapiroute saves your treadmill sessions in Apple Health as walks or runs.
